parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no<props="intl"><ph> **Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: LongJobId
parameters.description: The long-running task ID returned when the download task was created. For more information, see the **LongJobId** parameter in [CreateDownloadDataJob](~~445782~~).
